snippet:
def refresh_access_token(refresh_token):
    payload = verify_token(refresh_token)
    ...
    user = User.get(payload.get('user_id'))
    ...
    access_token, _ = generate_tokens(user)
    return access_token, None
failure_mode: Refresh tokens are never revoked/blacklisted and are not rotated on use. A stolen refresh token remains valid until its 30-day expiry (JWT_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES). Combined with the missing SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE flag (B2-03), token theft over the network is plausible.
fix_ref: Store issued refresh tokens (jti) in a DB table; check revocation on /refresh and rotate (invalidate old, issue new) on each use.
